evals.prompt: Génère les user stories à partir de docs/design.md. Fais tout d'un coup, sans t'arrêter au checkpoint.
evals.expected_output: INIT on a small design (auth + one resource): foundation, auth and catalog modules; FND-000; every constraint covered by a story and a test; abuse cases on protected stories; no priority; validate.py passes.
assertions: validate.py passes on the generated stories folder
FND-000 walking-skeleton story exists
Every data-model constraint is covered by at least one story and one test
Every feature story on a protected resource has abuse cases for horizontal and vertical access
No priority is invented (the design states none)
Stories are written in English (identifiers verbatim)
Entity.field references match the design verbatim
LLM: no feature, constraint or role absent from the design is added
LLM: stories are self-contained and specific enough for a weaker agent (no guessing needed)
